stock_category: Agency-held crude oil and finished petroleum products
stock_cover_basis: Statutory stockholding basis linked to average crude-oil and petroleum-product imports over a 90-day period; not a separately reported current days-cover value.
release_procedure: Release requires a Federal Ministerial decree specifying products, volumes and period. EBV says allocations are generally apportioned equally over four calendar weeks.
data_quality_notes: Approximate stockholding volume stated by EBV with no observation date. Do not interpret the statutory 90-day basis as an observed inventory days-cover value or infer a daily release rate.
